description: Source file implementing utility functions and classes for image processing, including surface manipulation, image saving, and utility classes for points and rectangles, within the Wesnoth game project.

classes.name: exploder_point
classes.description: Represents a 2D point with x and y coordinates, initialized from a string.

classes.name: exploder_rect
classes.description: Represents a rectangle with position (x,y) and size (w,h), initialized from a string.

methods.name: exploder_point::exploder_point
methods.description: Constructor that initializes a point from a string, splitting into two integers.

methods.name: exploder_rect::exploder_rect
methods.description: Constructor that initializes a rectangle from a string, splitting into four integers.

methods.name: get_mask_dir
methods.description: Returns the directory path for mask images used by the exploder tool.

methods.name: get_exploder_dir
methods.description: Returns the directory path for exploder tool data.

methods.name: masked_overwrite_surface
methods.description: Overwrites pixels in the destination surface with source surface pixels where the mask is not white, at a given position.

methods.name: image_empty
methods.description: Checks if an SDL surface is empty, either all transparent or all the same color.

methods.name: save_image
methods.description: Saves an SDL surface as a PNG image file.
